add_block.new_heading: What does hiring a private chef in Emirates Hills include?
new_paragraphs: Hiring a private chef in Emirates Hills is a door-to-door service, not just someone who cooks. From the first message we design a menu to your tastes and dietary needs, then the chef arrives with the ingredients, prepares everything in your own kitchen, plates each course and manages front-of-house through the evening. Where the guest count needs it, service staff join to pour, clear and reset between courses. When the last plate is cleared, the team washes down, packs out and leaves the kitchen exactly as they found it. That end-to-end scope is what separates a proper personal chef Emirates Hills booking from a drop-off tray: menu design, on-site cooking, plating, service, and a full cleanup are all handled. You keep the evening; we carry the work — from grocery run to final wipe-down.

add_block.new_heading: Villa access, styling and logistics in a gated community
new_paragraphs: Emirates Hills is strictly gated, so a smooth booking depends on logistics as much as cooking. We arrange chef and staff access, community-gate clearance and parking in advance so nobody is held at the entrance on the night. The mansions and grounds here suit formal, full front-of-house dinners and larger private events, and the chef plans around your kitchen layout, serving space and whether the meal moves indoors or onto the terrace. Styling matters too: plating, table dressing and the pace of service are all agreed beforehand so the evening feels considered instead of improvised. If you are hosting on the golf-course side or a signature waterfront plot, we factor in the walk from the gate and any equipment the menu needs. The aim is that your only job on the day is to greet your guests.

add_block.new_heading: Can you book a private chef full time, or only for one night?
new_paragraphs: Both, though the words matter. The full time private chef Dubai households picture is usually an employed, live-in cook, and that is a household staffing arrangement myCHEF does not make. What we do arrange is a standing booking: the same chef back on a fixed evening each week, a fortnightly dinner, or a run of dates across a season, so the household keeps one person who already knows the kitchen, the allergies and how you like things served. For everyday eating instead of entertaining, weekly meal prep cooks and stores a week of food in a single visit, from AED 1,898 per week for the lighter plan and AED 2,698 for the standard one. Plenty of Emirates Hills households run both: prep through the week, a chef on the nights that matter.

new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in Emirates Hills?
Private dining in Emirates Hills starts from about AED 700–950 per person, depending on guest count, menu and service level. Larger groups come down per head; send your numbers for an exact quote.

All of Emirates Hills — gated mansions across the Sectors (E, L, W and more), villas along the Montgomerie golf course and the surrounding streets — plus nearby Dubai communities. Confirm your exact address when you enquire.
What's included in villa chef Emirates Hills service?
Included is a vetted chef, service staff where needed, menu design, plating, setup and the full cleanup — a complete villa chef Emirates Hills service handled end to end.
How do I book?
Book by sharing your date, guest count and address; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
Can you cater weddings and large private events here?
Yes — Emirates Hills villa catering scales from intimate dinners to garden receptions and large celebrations, with plated menus, buffets or live stations to suit the setting and guest count.

Yes. A female chef can be requested for your booking. Tell us when you enquire and myCHEF matches you with a female chef from the partner network for your date, cuisine and service style. Ask when you send your date: availability depends on the date and the cuisine, and we confirm the match before anything is committed.
Do you handle gated-community access and parking?
Yes. We arrange chef and staff access, community-gate clearance and parking in advance so the team arrives on time and set-up runs smoothly.
Can I book a private chef full time in Emirates Hills?

Not as an employed or live-in cook — that is a household staffing arrangement myCHEF does not make. We do arrange standing bookings: the same chef back on a fixed evening each week or fortnight, and weekly meal prep from AED 1,898 per week for everyday cooking.
Are there reviews for private chef Emirates Hills?
Not yet. MyCHEF publishes client reviews as events run and will not post unattributed quotes in the meantime.
Can the menu be halal, vegetarian or allergen-aware?

Yes. Every menu can be built halal, and vegetarian and vegan options are standard. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
For private chef emirates hills, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
